headline: IIFL Finance Shares Drop Over 3% as Fairfax Reduces Ownership Stake
summary: Shares of IIFL Finance fell more than 3% in Mumbai after institutional investor Fairfax sold over 5.65 crore shares via open market block deals on Wednesday.
why: IIFL Finance is an Indian non-banking financial company providing gold, home, and business loans.

impacts.name: IIFL Finance
impacts.why: A major stake sale by Fairfax via open market block deals pressured IIFL Finance stock price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Large-scale institutional share divestment created short-term excess equity supply on the exchange.
